name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for email, funnels, courses, and sales, with a public REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: Public API key sent in the X-API-Key header. Up to 3 API keys per account. A separate MCP key is used for the MCP server. OAuth is planned but not released.
access_notes: Keys are generated in the dashboard profile settings under Public API keys. The pages do not state which plan tiers include API access or any cost.

buildability.rationale: Documented public REST API with API key auth and self-serve key creation. Plan tier that includes API access is not stated in the pages, so confidence is medium.

identity.quote: allowing you to manage contacts, tags, and a variety of other operations integral to our platform.

auth.quote: your only option right now is to attach your API key to the X-API-Key header of each request.
This is an initial release implementation and does not yet support the recommended authentication method (OAuth).

access.quote: Simply navigate to the profile settings within your Systeme.io dashboard

api_surface.quote: Adhering to RESTful conventions, our API ensures an intuitive and consistent interaction pattern for all users.
Our API employs a cursor-based pagination system for efficiently navigating through large collections of resources.

mcp.quote: For technical details, please refer to our official MCP documentation: https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server

buildability.quote: Contacts: Create new contacts, update existing ones, list your audience with advanced filters, or delete contacts.

needs_human_reason: The plan tier that includes public API access and the API cost are not stated in the cached pages.
